name: @bridge/recorder
description: Internal tool (headless capability, no nav/route): capture + transcribe. Engine extracted from Tools/recorder; the FastAPI+Whisper backend stays a Python sidecar behind this typed port, same pattern as Docling/Resume-Matcher (docs/raw/tool-standardization-plan.md, Phase 2, ADR-006).
